from pathlib import Path
import collections, importlib.util
progdir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u078/system/state/workspace/programs')
progdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    base = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != base)
    separator = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marked = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
              if grid[r][c] != base and grid[r][c] != separator]
    if not marked:
        return [[base]]
    rmin, rmax = min(r for r, c in marked), max(r for r, c in marked)
    cmin, cmax = min(c for r, c in marked), max(c for r, c in marked)
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if rmin <= r <= rmax and sum(v != base for v in grid[r]) >= w / 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if cmin <= c <= cmax and sum(grid[r][c] != base for r in range(h)) >= h / 2]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        line = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            corners = [grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1], grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1]]
            if corners[0] == corners[1] == corners[2] == corners[3] and corners[0] not in (base, separator):
                line.append(corners[0])
            else:
                line.append(base)
        out.append(line)
    return out
'''
path=progdir/'task-564ea0a3.py'

spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog',path); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
def synth(h,w,base,sep,rs,cs,nodes,extra=None):
    g=[[base]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in rs:
        for c in range(w): g[r][c]=sep
    for c in cs:
        for r in range(h): g[r][c]=sep
    for i,r in enumerate(rs):
        for j,c in enumerate(cs):
            if (i,j) in nodes: g[r][c]=nodes[(i,j)]
    if extra:
        for (r,c),v in extra.items(): g[r][c]=v
    return g
# Demo 1
